dedupe_keys.name: rufiji basin water board monthly hydrological reports for the nyerere jnhpp and mtera dams

description: The Rufiji Basin Water Board publishes monthly hydrological reports and water status reports (Taarifa ya hali ya maji) for two large dams in the Rufiji basin: the Julius Nyerere hydropower dam (JNHPP) and the Mtera dam. The reports page lists a report for each dam each month, the latest dated 1 September 2026 for August 2026, with older months on a second page. Coverage is the Rufiji river basin in Tanzania, one of the country's largest basins and the source of most of its hydropower. Access is free from the board's public website, with no sign-in. Caveats: the reports are in Swahili, their contents (levels, inflows or releases) were not opened in the cloud session, and the length of the back catalogue was not checked beyond the first two pages. Simulation uses: monthly reservoir state of two major dams for water allocation, hydropower and drought studies. Related records: Kariba lake levels and river flows from the Zambezi River Authority (data-zra-kariba-lake-levels-reservoir-river-flows).
